notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable inherited-attribute lookup development slice to the exact 2025 C++ API surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies only the official signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and real Catch2 selectors. The functional scenario distinguishes an invalid object-class handle, an invalid attribute handle, and a valid handle not defined for the supplied class; the companion service-report scenario decodes the accepted type-36/type-53 forms through the native HLA_IMMEDIATE MOM route. The Lab exports no higher-level implementation mapping for these services, so this is source/API traceability only: it is not a catalog, JUnit result, protected-review result, production package claim, or conformance claim.
